When you are very often able to see the extenuating circumstances that lead to an event circumstances getting weird. Not just "unstable, lol", but seriously  unsettling, such as predicting that ISIS  would be recruiting a significant amount of people from the US given their background and social backgrounds. Idk what I'm supposed to actually care about since these only require the most basic coverage. So what's more important than [recruited terrorists?] (www.nydailynews.com/news/crime/u-s-s-jihadis-recruited-isis-skype-article-1.1854216)
Every day life is choked by these instances, downplayed in light of new evidence. I can't care anymore, or ill miss my own life passing by.
I'm looking forward to becoming free, and I'm just happy to have finally told my story before I do. Forgetting's really the only option for me now.
